query:
SELECT 
  SUM(cat1) as Avulso,
  SUM(cat2) as ServExtra,
  SUM(cat3) as Auxiliar,
  SUM(cat6) as Caixinha,
  SUM(cat7) as Barbiero,
  SUM(cat8) as Bar,
  SUM(cat9) as Recorrencia,
  SUM(cat1+cat2+cat3+cat4+cat5+cat6+cat7+cat8) as totalSemRecorrencia,
  SUM(cat9) as totalRecorrencia,
  SUM(cat1+cat2+cat3+cat4+cat5+cat6+cat7+cat8+cat9) as grandTotal
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE empresaSlug = 'barbiero-morumbi' 
  AND data BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-15';
